name: La Esperanza (Colombia)
description: Horizontal bicolour of green and yellow with a white triangle at the hoist, the green charged with a large white five-pointed star surrounded by four small ones.
history: Municipal flag of La Esperanza, a municipality in the department of Norte de Santander, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: large star with four small stars around it
